text: You have a girlfriend and then you suddenly find out that she's seeing another guy. What to do? Damn, the questions I receive sometimes are wild. I need your advice, bro. What will I do if my girlfriend, she was seeing her ex last year, December. It all started like this. When I asked her out, she said that she broke up with her boyfriend, but I didn't know that they were still going out. So while she was going out with me, she was also going out with him. He asked her out first, they were together first, but she cheated on him with me and I didn't know. So for three months, she was seeing both of us, but I didn't know that she had another boyfriend and he probably didn't know about me. Man, so she wasn't cheating on him with you. She was also cheating on you with him. She was seeing both of you for three months. Now I'm curious what the question will be. Who out of you two is a bigger fool? On Christmas, when I visited her, I found out about the other boyfriend, but she said that they broke up and they are not together, I suppose. I was a fool, bro. I believed her again. After the holidays, our relationship bonded a bit. And then when I left in January, she was still seeing the other boyfriend, but this time her emotions were different towards him and her reaction was different towards him. They probably got into arguments and then they broke up because of me, because her reaction was different towards him. Okay, so 10 points to this other guy. It seems like when he found out that she was seeing you at the same time, they broke up, but you still stayed with her, man. So kudos to that other dude. Yes, he may be inexperienced, probably a bit naive, but at least when he found out that she was with another dude, he ended it and you didn't. Then she started putting me on all of her profile pictures and putting my name in all of her accounts on social media. Yeah, man, such an achievement for you. She lied to me two times and this time she said it's a dead end for good. I even WhatsApped the ex and he also said it's a dead end for good. But he's still bothering her and for one month now she's not entertaining him. I just found out two days ago about everything, so what should I do? Man, what should you do? Such a difficult question. Are you watching my channel with your ass? Remember, you are calling her your girlfriend, and for three months she was sleeping with another dude. Who knows, maybe now she's cheating on you with someone else. Don't forgive cheating, man. You should have broken up with her the moment you found out about it. End of the story. And as much as you are trying to trash that other guy, he actually seems to have more self-respect than you. Write in the comments, what do you think, guys? My name is Ilyas Abdulian. Thanks a lot and bye.
